source.title: How to make potato soup (ladder unit, machine-drafted)
source.author: Go course authors (drafted by an AI model)
source.attribution: Course-authored controlled German. Drafted by an AI model; not yet reviewed by a native speaker.
source.provenance: Drafted by an AI model for the course ladder; not reviewed by a native speaker. It is controlled, deliberately repetitive German written for learners and may contain unnatural phrasing. The English lines are the drafter's own.
source.licenseNote: Owned by the course authors; machine-drafted, not yet native-reviewed.

review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native-speaker review. Marta explains the soup in the kitchen (du to Ben and Sam). The imperative forms are du (schneide, nimm, gib), ihr (nehmt) and Sie (nehmen Sie, a joke between friends, in a recipe voice). "Man" is a plain, ordinary word that the plan did not schedule (three uses); "bisschen" is only used in "ein bisschen". The recipe is plain (soup with potatoes, onion, oil, salt, pepper, water) and has no quantities except twenty minutes. The talk at the table recycles the earlier weekend and trip vocabulary.

sentences.english: It is Saturday.

sentences.text: Marta, Ben und Sam sind in der Küche.
sentences.english: Marta, Ben and Sam are in the kitchen.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Heute kochen wir Suppe mit Kartoffeln.
sentences.english: Today we are making soup with potatoes.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: Here are the ingredients.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Man braucht Kartoffeln, eine Zwiebel, Salz, Pfeffer, Öl und Wasser.
sentences.english: You need potatoes, an onion, salt, pepper, oil and water.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: And a vegetable: tomatoes.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: Vegetables are good for Ben.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: I do not understand the word "Zutat".

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Eine Zutat ist etwas für die Suppe.
sentences.english: An ingredient is something for the soup.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Im Kurs hat Eva das erklärt, aber ich habe es nicht gut verstanden.
sentences.english: In the course Eva explained it, but I did not understand it well.

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.english: I want to help!

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: Take the pot, Ben.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: Take the pan too.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Das Messer ist für mich, nicht für Kinder.
sentences.english: The knife is for me, not for children.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: Do not take the knife, Ben!

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: Sam, here is a spoon.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: And here are the plates.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: Cut the onion.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Gib ein bisschen Öl in die Pfanne.
sentences.english: Put a little oil in the pan.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Gib die Zwiebel in die Pfanne.
sentences.english: Put the onion in the pan.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: Cut the potatoes.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Gib die Kartoffeln in den Topf.
sentences.english: Put the potatoes in the pot.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Gib Wasser in den Topf, und koche die Kartoffeln.
sentences.english: Put water in the pot, and cook the potatoes.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Gib ein bisschen Salz und ein bisschen Pfeffer in die Suppe.
sentences.english: Put a little salt and a little pepper in the soup.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: You cook the soup for 20 minutes.

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.english: Do you hear?

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.english: The water is boiling!

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.text: Ich höre es mit dem Ohr.
sentences.english: I can hear it with my ear.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Nimm einen Löffel, Sam, und koste die Suppe.
sentences.english: Take a spoon, Sam, and taste the soup.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: It is very tasty!

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Ihr könnt den Tisch machen: Nehmt die Teller und die Löffel.
sentences.english: You can set the table: take the plates and the spoons.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Und jetzt, Herr Miller, nehmen Sie bitte den Salat.
sentences.english: And now, Mr Miller, please take the salad.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: Gladly!

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: But where is the salad?

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: We are making it now.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: Cut the tomatoes, Sam.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Gib Salz und Öl in den Salat.
sentences.english: Put salt and oil in the salad.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: Here is the pepper too.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Das Gemüse ist im Salat, und das Messer liegt neben dem Teller.
sentences.english: The vegetables are in the salad, and the knife is next to the plate.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: And the bread?

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: I bake the bread.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: Yesterday I baked bread.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: Baking is not easy.
The soup is ready.

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.english: The soup is so tasty!

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.text: Mein Teller ist voll, aber dein Teller ist leer, Sam.
sentences.english: My plate is full, but your plate is empty, Sam.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: We eat the soup hot.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Wir können sie auch beim Picknick am See essen, nach einem Ausflug in den Wald.
sentences.english: We can also eat it at a picnic at the lake, after an excursion in the forest.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Ich koche sie, wenn Freunde mich besuchen.
sentences.english: I cook it when friends visit me.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: The neighbour is coming today too.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Meine Ärztin sagt: Suppe ist gut, wenn man krank ist.
sentences.english: My doctor says: soup is good when you are ill.

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.english: I am photographing the soup!

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Nimm dein Foto, Ben, und iss die Suppe!
sentences.english: Take your photo, Ben, and eat the soup!

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Ben, was hast du am Wochenende gemacht?
sentences.english: Ben, what did you do at the weekend?

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.text: Ich bin im Wald gelaufen, und ich bin ins Wasser gesprungen.
sentences.english: I walked in the forest, and I jumped into the water.

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.text: Ich habe den Ball geworfen, und Max hat ihn gefangen.
sentences.english: I threw the ball, and Max caught it.

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.english: We also swam.

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.text: Der Berg war weit, aber wir sind gelaufen.
sentences.english: The hill was far, but we walked.

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.english: I met a girl.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: That is nice.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: And what is Papa doing?

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.text: Papa hat in Dresden im Hotel übernachtet, und er hat ein Museum besucht.
sentences.english: Papa stayed in a hotel in Dresden, and he visited a museum.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Ich habe im Geschäft am Bahnhof Salz gekauft.
sentences.english: I bought salt at the shop at the station.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Und ich habe Frau Weber Tomaten geschenkt.
sentences.english: And I gave Mrs Weber tomatoes.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Viele Freunde kommen, und jeder bringt etwas mit.
sentences.english: Many friends come, and everyone brings something.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Ich war einmal im Café und im Museum, und nach dem Konzert hatte ich Hunger.
sentences.english: I was once in a café and in a museum, and after the concert I was hungry.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Du bist ein guter Nachbar, Marta.
sentences.english: You are a good neighbour, Marta.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Ich bin bei Frau Weber eingezogen.
sentences.english: I have moved in at Mrs Weber's.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Im Kurs habe ich viele Fehler gemacht, aber die Lehrerin ist gut.
sentences.english: In the course I made many mistakes, but the teacher is good.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Sie erklärt die Grammatik, und ich übe die Sprache jeden Tag.
sentences.english: She explains the grammar, and I practise the language every day.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: You speak well, Sam.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: That is a good course.
